narrative.title: Nearest Extinguisher Mapping
narrative.scenario: A data-hall floor plan marks equipment racks (1) and extinguisher stations (0). For every rack cell, the safety map must state the walking distance — steps across edge-adjacent floor cells — to the closest extinguisher. Stations themselves report 0.
narrative.inputFormat: An m x n binary matrix mat containing at least one 0.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an m x n matrix where each cell holds the distance to its nearest 0.
constraints: At least one 0 exists in the matrix

testCases.explanation: The lone rack sits one step from extinguishers on every side.
Distances ripple outward from the zero row; the far corner needs two steps.

hintLevels: Level 1: Don't search from each 1 — flood from every 0 at once and let distances fall where they may.
Level 2: Seed the queue with all zeros at distance 0; each BFS ring adds exactly one step.
Level 3: A cell's answer is final the first time the wave reaches it — no relaxation passes needed.
